summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K to report the voting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on June 2, 2026. All director nominees were re-elected, shareholders voted 99.25% in favor of setting the number of directors at eight, and 78.64% in favor of reappointing KPMG LLP as auditor. No special situation or transaction terms (price, premium, break fee) were disclosed. This is a routine meeting update, equivalent to a U.S. 8-K for shareholder meeting results, with no material corporate action.
